dct_description_sm: This data set contains the eight (8) scans collected to document the effects of dismantling the Perrenoud Homestead due to safety concerns. This data is the third of five data sets. The data was collected with the Z+F 5010X by the Capture2Preserve Team on July 20 201. This was the second day of dismantling the house stead. The data was processed with Laser Control v. 8.9.
